description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of emotional categories across a dataset of speaker anonymized speech, with six distinct slices corresponding to the emotions: Frustration (25.1%, light blue), Neutral (23.1%, dark blue), Anger (14.9%, yellow), Happiness (8.1%, light blue), Excitement (14.1%, red), and Sadness (the proportion is obscured by a gray overlay, making its exact percentage unreadable). The chart includes percentage labels directly within each slice and a legend that maps colors to emotions, although the Sadness slice’s color is not visible due to the overlay. The segments are arranged in a clockwise descending order by size, starting from the top with Frustration, followed by Neutral, Anger, Sadness, Excitement, and Happiness. No slices are visually emphasized through explosion or bolding.
